intro: The Delivery to Mathias is a sealed parcel entrusted to promising rogues by Keryn Sylvius in Goldshire. Handing it over to Master Mathias Shaw grants an aspiring operative entry into the inner workings of SI:7 in Stormwind.

p: To the untrained eye, carrying a simple parcel from the Lion's Pride Inn to the Stormwind Barracks seems like mundane courier work. Yet for budding rogues, the package serves as an audition for Stormwind Intelligence. Handed over by local trainer Keryn Sylvius, it offers novice cutpurses a direct introduction to Master Mathias Shaw, testing their ability to navigate the capital, keep a low profile, and follow discreet orders without asking questions.

Delivering the package brings an operative directly into the heart of SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. Mathias Shaw uses such handoffs to weed out pretenders from true talents. Those who present the parcel without faltering are rewarded with high-stakes field assignments, starting with covert reconnaissance and infiltration against Defias smuggling networks in Elwynn Forest.
